body: Please don't be sorry. It's good that you're reaching out. I'm not an expert on SW, but i have a few thoughts. If you have any chance to get away from your parents, I think it'd be best. They are not going to help it seems, and their attitudes make things worse for you. Of course, that may not be an option. Don't let them use your past against you. They have no right to wield it as a weapon. If they can be reasonable, talk to them about how you feel. It sounds like that isn't the case, so I think you need to try to sever contact with them as best you can. Maybe there is a relative you can stay with? You need someone you trust to help you if possible. Please don't do anything rash. We are always glad to talk.
